name: White Cat / Endurance-inspired Space Station
palette: Inherited from mars rover.blend: Ceramic white, Graphite, Gunmetal, Amber, Solar blue.
runtime_notes: Load one LOD at a time. Two mesh objects, one material, two nominal draws before shadows/passes.
No Draco, WebP or external texture decoder required; PNG atlas embedded in each GLB.
Origin at rotation centre. Approximate decorative scale, not spacecraft engineering data.
Suggested LOD selection by projected diameter: LOD0 > 350 px, LOD1 100–350 px, LOD2 < 100 px. Tune on target device.
credits: Station geometry and atlas created for White Cat from supplied photograph.
Adapted dish: NASA Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter 3D model; preserve nasa_mro_3d credit in data/sources.json.
Photograph supplied by user, retained as reference only; not embedded in game assets.
revision_2026_11_15: Remove auxiliary solar-looking panels on central station craft (image 1).
